description: One problem of the register (doc/problems.jsonl, one problem a line), written only by tools/atlas (problems add, update, close, drop, import, import-gates). What no keyword states is the register gate's (tools/gates/gate_data.py check_register): ids unique and never reused, an unknown cause with the reading that would find it, a fix for every fixed problem, a closing date only on a fixed or dropped one, related ids that exist, evidence that exists.

symptom.description: what the player or the owner sees

cause.description: the design decision that produces it, or "unknown" (then reading is required)

reading.description: what must be read to find the cause; required while the cause is unknown

owner.description: the one owner (file and symbol) of the decision, or the tool

criterion.description: the check that closes it: a test, a measure, an analysed photo, a gate

evidence.description: paths under dist/evidence/<id>/ or elsewhere on disk, or git references written git:<ref>

origin.description: where it came from: pendencias.md:S1, trace:port-from-nov7#P412, performance.md:P-13, gate:<RULE>:<file>, run:<run id>

spec.description: the specification that will fix it

traced.description: when the status first left open for traced: a report's time to its located cause

closed.description: set only with the status fixed or dropped

fix.description: what changed and why it cannot return; required for fixed (for dropped: why it is no problem)
